description_sq:
Shesim apartament 1+1 ne zone e Don Boskos, Rruga Muzaket.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7-te te nje pallati shume cilesor me ashensor dhe ka siperfaqje te totale 54m2.
Organizimi eshte i rregullt me korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes & kuzhine, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.
Ka orientim te favorshem per ndricim natyral gjate dites. Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne menyre cilesore.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me teper informacion apo vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni.
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in the area of ​​Don Bosko, Muzaket Street. The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a high-quality building with an elevator and has a total area of ​​54m2. The organization is regular with a corridor that divides the living room & kitchen, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. It has a favorable orientation for natural lighting during the day. The apartment is invested in a quality way. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
